Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Gungnir V4 development candidate: two active skills, authoritative combat, native aim adapter, original spear art. Strict remote player movement authority and final Android/network visual acceptance are not yet verified. Authorized SCIE port for SCNET x25.01.17. v0.30.0 rebuilds Skywrath skills 2 and 3 around a real ribbon lightning system: each bolt is a continuous jagged polyline expanded into camera-facing quads with a white core, a blue halo and branches, plus ground rune seals and impact flashes. Thunderous Judgment now charges for 0.42 s and then releases 10-12 radial bolts (110 inside 4 blocks, decaying to 70 at 9). Myriad Tribulation drops the old 24-target sweep for one authoritative main bolt (220/120/70 inside 8 blocks, four 18-damage aftershock ticks) plus a client-side deterministic backdrop storm that deals no damage and never loads chunks. Android rendering, touch HUD and multiplayer remain pending device verification.
